:::{#def-integers}
#### Integers

The **integers**
[@wikipedia_integer]
are the whole numbers,
together with their negatives and $0$:

$$\mathbb{Z} \eqdef \cb{\ldots, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, \ldots}$$

An **integer** is an element of $\mathbb{Z}$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-positive-integer}
#### Positive integers

The integers (@def-integers) greater than $0$ are the **positive integers**.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-negative-integer}
#### Negative integers

The integers (@def-integers) less than $0$ are the **negative integers**.

:::
